exposure: sequential anticoagulation (heparins in the first trimester and peripartum period and VKAs for the remainder of pregnancy)
warfarin >5 mg in the first trimester
cohort: The study included 138 pregnancies in 121 women with mechanical heart valves (MHVs) at a tertiary centre in South India.
finding: The study found no significant differences in major maternal and neonatal outcomes (maternal deaths, thromboembolic events, haemorrhagic/cardiac complications, miscarriages, stillbirths, neonatal deaths) between women on VKAs throughout pregnancy and those on sequential anticoagulation, though warfarin embryopathy was associated with >5 mg warfarin in the first trimester.
